data.memory_usage_summary: Thin Route Handler Pattern reinforced the move of pure utilities into the domain layer to keep the use-case route-free; "ensure utility functions are called in relevant handlers" guided verification that all 3 import sites (use case + github-pre-events route + tests) were updated to the new domain/utils paths.
data.summary:
* Fixed the architectural finding (raised in all 3 reviews): moved `extractEventUrl.ts` + `extractEventSummary.ts` and their tests from `apps/code-agent/src/routes/code/` to `apps/code-agent/src/domain/utils/`, updated imports in `processGitHubWebhook.ts` and `routes/code/github-pre-events.ts`.
  * Skipped the v8-ignore comment (FakeFirestore limitation; ≥95% coverage already met; prior remediation 0aa2fb3 already removed a separate v8 ignore on the dedup-fallback path).
  * Skipped the `as never` test-fixture comment (standard codebase pattern for testing ill-typed payloads; type-safety loss bounded to tests).
  * Skipped the `decidedBy: 'webhook_route'` rename (Firestore-persisted audit discriminator + port type union + 10+ test fixtures; rename would fracture historical analytics).
  * Deferred the suggested `domain → routes` ESLint rule because adding it surfaced pre-existing violations in `whatsapp-service` (out of this PR's scope); pushed `f32fb4c09` to `feature/int-1434`, all CI checks green.
